notes.title: ⚔️ Major Update Out Now – New Realm Available! ⚔️
notes.notes:
Fellow Vikings!
The wait is over! We’re thrilled to launch this Major Update right as gamescom kicks off. If you’re visiting the show, make sure to stop by our booth in the Indie Arena (Hall 10.2) and say hi. We’d love to meet you!


What's new you ask? Here we go:  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]
🛠️ Update 0.2.1.g – New Realm, New Mode, New Bosses

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/14fbd069e123ce71a3c8c6ed93f5d564bfbdc254.png"]
Quickmode: 
A brand-new mode for those who like their battles fast and furious! Runs are now capped at 10 minutes, making farming smoother and perfect for short, intense sessions.


Alfheim: 
Venture into the mystical lands of Alfheim, filled with new enemies and a fearsome mini boss waiting to test your strength.


Vanaheim Boss: 
The realm of Vanaheim finally sees the arrival of its true ruler—brace yourself for an epic showdown against its powerful endboss.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]



We’re excited to keep expanding Asgard’s Fall. Once gamescom wraps up, we’ll dive right back into working on new features and updates. So stay hyped for what’s to come!


❤️ Thank You
Your support and feedback mean the world to us. Please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions; we’re always looking to improve and grow Asgard’s Fall together with you.

See you in battle, and maybe even at gamescom!


Skål!🍻 — Max & Vitali | The Asgard’s Fall Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.1.d
notes.notes:
Known Issues

 Disappearing Warpaints & Warpaint duplication. We potentially fixed the disappearing Warpaints but we still rely on your feedback here. Please report anything related to this issue. We are still working on the Warpaint duplication bug. Thank you for your patience! <3


Added

 Added a new NPC returning your lost Pigments from before the system rework.
 New Warpaint forms added. Mythic and Legendary Warpaints will continue to use the same forms. Epic and Common Warpaints will now drop in smaller forms to compensate for their reduced power. To prevent your current loadouts from being affected, this does not apply retroactively to older Warpaints. More shapes will be added in the future.


Changed

 Blood Sacrifice rewards changed. We have changed the way that levels affect the rarity of Warpaints dropped by enemies and chests. The higher the level, the more likely you are to receive legendary or mythical Warpaints and the less likely you are to receive common or epic Warpaints. You can also see the exact chances for each rarity.


Fixed

 Potentially fixed a bug that resulted in losing equipped Warpaints. Please report any issues regarding this topic.
 Fixed a bug where the unique effect “Fortunes Favor” gave you a random ability at the start of the run instead of a free reroll each level up.
 Fixed a bug where the Valhalla mode was not properly reset after a full Blood Sacrifice reset.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.1.c
notes.notes:
We’ve heard your feedback and are currently working on transferring your old pigment inventory to the new system so that your progress from before the update is not lost. It will not be exactly the same amount, as the purpose and the pigments themselves have changed, but we are working on a solution that reflects the time you have already invested. We sadly can’t restore any Warpaints from the old system but we are going to implement new ways to make Warpaint farming easier - we apologize for that!

Notes:

Changed

 Boss chests now drop at least 1 legendary Warpaint.


Fixed

 Fixed a bug that crashed the game when hovering over a mythic Warpaint.
 Fixed a UI related problem that sometimes required multiple attempts to properly select a button when clicking or hovering over it.
 Fixed another Warpaint duplication bug.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.1.b
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that restrained legendary warpaints from being able to contain unique effects.
 Fixed a bug that made it possible to duplicate Warpaints and may crash the game.

notes.title: ⚔️ Major Update Out Now – Warpaints Reforged! ⚔️
notes.notes:
Greetings Vikings!
It’s been a while since our last update, and we truly appreciate your patience. The road here wasn’t without its bumps, especially as we tackled the ambitious rework of one of Asgard’s Fall's core systems. 

But we’re back, and we're thrilled to announce that the Major Update is live now!

This update focuses heavily on refining and improving existing mechanics, delivering much-requested quality-of-life enhancements, and setting the stage for exciting new content to come. At the heart of it all is the Warpaint System, now fully reworked and more powerful than ever before. 


Dive into the full changelog below:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]
🛠️ Update 0.2.1.a – Warpaint System Rework

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/14fbd069e123ce71a3c8c6ed93f5d564bfbdc254.png"]
Warpaint Loadouts are now available.

Mass-destroy functions for all Warpaint rarities.

Stat overview panel showing the combined effects of your current Warpaint Loadout.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f4d66ab4333feb6404f7de8709e40ca69d95cc02.png"]
Complete rework of the Warpaint System (includes a full reset; 👉👈 sorry).

Warpaints are now organized in the inventory via drag & drop.

Warpaints can be equipped directly from the inventory into the Warpaint Grid.

New rarities introduced: Common → Epic → Legendary → Mythic.

Warpaint stats now roll in Tiers 1–4, each with its own stat range.

Legendary Warpaints feature unique effects (limited to one of each effect equipped).

Warpaints now generate Rune Essence, to be used in a future Crafting System.

Pigments have been reset; they’ll return as a core resource in upcoming crafting mechanics.

Destroying Warpaints now yields Pigments based on their stats and rarity.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/62b5d27bde006980842575dac405a0b11e3bf960.png"]

Resolved a saving issue where Warpaints could disappear from the grid.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/2d153069937be0a9e95ade7b34c9fba91debe6db.png"]

Warpaint Patterns have been removed. These effects are now possible on Legendary Warpaints.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]

🔮 Looking Ahead: Crafting, Content & More!
This update was all about refinement—tightening up mechanics, improving flow, and paving the way for what's next. The Warpaint System was a massive focus, and we’re proud of how it's shaping the mid- and late-game experience.

You might’ve noticed that Pigments are currently gone. Don't worry, they're not gone forever. They'll return in of the upcoming Major Updates (sooner than later) as part of a brand-new Crafting System that we're actively developing. So hang tight! This is just the beginning.

And yes, you heard that right: new content is coming, and it’s already in the works. Expect fresh news and sneak peeks very soon!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]



Thank you so much for sticking with us on this journey. Your patience and support mean the world to us and help Asgard’s Fall grow into the saga we’ve always dreamed of. Until then—grab your axes, reapply those warpaints, and survive with honor!



Skål!🍻 — Max & Vitali | The Asgard’s Fall Team

notes.title: 🛡️ Dev Update – A Sign from the Halls of Asgard 🛡️
notes.notes:
Warriors!

We’re sending out a vital sign from the dev forge to let you know: we’re still here, hammering away—just a bit deeper in the code mines than expected.

We know many of you have been eagerly awaiting the major update originally planned for May, and we’re truly sorry for the delay. As you may know, this update includes a complete overhaul of the Warpaint system, and that journey turned out to be more treacherous than we anticipated.

Digging into the ancient foundations of the Warpaint and Rune systems, we realized that parts of the old code simply couldn’t keep up with our ambitions. So, we took a deep breath… and rewrote entire parts of the system from scratch. It’s a bold move, but one we believe is necessary to deliver the experience you deserve. Also enabling us to shape future updates based on these systems to be even better.

To show you we’re not just stuck in the Bifröst, here’s a short sneak peek of the new Warpaint UI and some freshly reforged Runes in action! 📽️

[previewyoutube=iR5YVWpZCOY;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re working hard—and fast—to finish what we started. While we can't give you an exact date just yet, the update is taking shape rapidly and we hope to have it release-ready very soon.

Thank you for your patience, your feedback, and your continued support. Your belief in Asgard’s Fall keeps our hammers swinging and our mead mugs full. 🖤

Skål!🍻
— Max & Vitali | The Asgard’s Fall Team

notes.title: 👀A Glimpse into the Next Major Update👀
notes.notes:
Fellow Vikings!

Here we are with a first look at the upcoming major update for Asgard’s Fall! One of the headline changes is a full overhaul of the Warpaint system, with a ton of long-requested improvements and fresh mechanics that will shake up how you build and customize your characters.

Inventory Gets a Makeover
Warpaints now live side by side with your inventory, and managing your gear just got a whole lot smoother:

 Inventory now displayed right next to your Warpaint
 Filtering & sorting options for easier navigation
 Bigger inventory with multiple pages
 Mass dematerializing for faster cleanup
 Lock specific items to avoid accidents
 Build loadouts unique to each character
 See active Warpaint effects at a glance

Here's a scribble of the new inventory management menu for Warpaints:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/0e2eb0268cc24561815581d14fa2888b62a0cf45.png

Warpaint Runes – New Structure, New Power
Warpaint recipes are gone—all their effects are now baked right into the Runes themselves. This new system is all about flexibility and surprise:

 Warpaints come in rarity tiers: Common, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, and Unique
 Each tier offers a different number of random stat bonuses
 Example: Common = 2 stats, Mythic = 4 stats
 Unique Runes feature an exclusive bonus effect that’s one-of-a-kind!
 The world pigment drops will also change in this respect, as the new pigments will then drop.

Check out the graphic below for a breakdown of rune rarities and stats!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/573c8c7bff46698df235632b7c4d63260ed69f5d.png

Pigments and Crafting – What’s Next?
Pigments will also evolve alongside this update. Any pigments in your inventory will likely be converted automatically.

However, full Warpaint crafting is planned for a future update, as it's still under development and not ready for testing just yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png

That’s all for now!
The major update is dropping very soon, and we can’t wait to share it with you. We're also working on community beta branches to give you earlier access and more opportunities to shape each update as it grows together.

Stay sharp, warriors—and keep those brushes ready. The battlefield's about to get a lot more colorful.

Skål!🍻
— Max & Vitali | The Asgard’s Fall Team

notes.title: ⚔️ Asgard’s Fall – Balance Update Now Live! ⚔️
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings! 

We’re back with a new Asgard’s Fall update, and this one’s all about balance! From faster summons to reworked damage values and skill tweaks, this patch should shake up your builds and make the battlefield feel even more dynamic.

Let’s dive into the details:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f4d66ab4333feb6404f7de8709e40ca69d95cc02.png
 Summons:

 Increased movement speed for all summons
 Reduced attack cooldown for all summons
 Ride of the Valkyries: Adjusted behavior and increased initial spawn from 2 → 4
 Flamebound Leech: Increased initial spawn from 1 → 3, removed upgrade scaling

 Ability Balance:
Adjusted upgrade weights for several overperforming skills


 Magma Sphere: Damage 70 → 80, now has 50% chance to Ignite
 Ember Axes: Damage 75 → 65
 Jotunnfire Outburst: Damage 45 → 55
 Fiery Rune: Damage 30 → 45
 Glacial Sunder: Damage 30 → 45
 Arctic Assault: Damage 60 → 80
 Ymir’s Avalanche: Damage 25 → 30, now has 50% chance to Chill
 Frost Trap: Projectiles now freeze enemies
 Gungnir: Damage 30 → 40
 Yggdrasil’s Pulse: Now has 50% chance to Shock
 Spear of the Elder: Adjusted attack radius and damage during its cycle
 Forged: Temporarily increased damage by ~50% while under rework

 Knot of Fate Adjustments:

 Chain Lightning: Now 15% chance to Shock
 Searing Path: Lifetime 2.5s → 5s, damage 5 → 10
 Blood Frenzy: 0.25% chance to increase attack speed by 0.5% until hit
 Frontline: Now shows a range indicator
 Fiery Prowess: Now grants 0.5% fire damage (was 1%)

 Class Updates:

 Seer: Golem from Blood Ritual now periodically uses Plague Burst
 Warrior: Thorn damage 35 → 45
 Huntress: Wolf companion bleed chance 10% → 50%
 Viking’s Resolve cooldown reduction 15% → 10%

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png

That’s it for now, warriors! We'll be sharing the first details about the next major update very soon—stay tuned and prepare for what’s coming next in Asgard’s Fall!

Skål!🍻
— Max & Vitali | The Asgard’s Fall Team

notes.title: ⚔️ A Patch Fit for the Gods ⚔️
notes.notes:
Fellow Vikings! 

The forge has been burning hot! We've been hard at work sharpening the edges of Asgard’s Fall, and today's patch is packed with quality-of-life improvements, balancing updates, and much-needed bug fixes. 

From fine-tuning abilities and damage scaling to reworking key systems like Warpaints and controls—this update is all about making your journey through the Nine Realms smoother and more thrilling. 

Read on for all the juicy details!

IMPORTANT NOTE: With this patch, we’re preparing your save files for the upcoming Steam Cloud Save feature. The feature will be activated within the next 1–2 days, so we kindly ask you to play only on the device where you’ve made the most progress during this time. Once activated, your progress will automatically be uploaded to the cloud. Thank you for your understanding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/14fbd069e123ce71a3c8c6ed93f5d564bfbdc254.png


 Added a controls menu to rebind keys. (We're still working on this system to include more control options.)
 Added confirmation popups for closing the game, ending a run, and resetting Warpaints.
 Added tooltips to the compendium. The compendium can now also be accessed during a run.
 Added an indicator for newly dropped Warpaints in your inventory.
 Added a 150% movement speed cap to make other defensive options more valuable. We've also increased the roll values on all other defensive stats to make them easier to improve.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f4d66ab4333feb6404f7de8709e40ca69d95cc02.png


 Inventory can now be accessed inside the Warpaint Hut, making navigation easier. (This is a temporary fix before a complete overhaul of the Warpaint System in a future update.)
 Increased the chance to get higher-tier stats on epic and legendary Warpaints.
 Increased the drop chance for common pigments by 50%.
 Increased the drop chance for epic pigments by 50%.
 Reduced required hero XP for level-ups by 20%.
 Decreased the base enemy scaling curve by 30%

 Muspelheim:
 Reduced damage dealt by Molten Slime by 50%.
 Reduced damage dealt by the Flaming Skull Wall by 20%.
 Reduced movement speed of the Flaming Skull Wall by 10%.
 Balance Changes:
 Changed Warpaint Pattern “Sigil of Elements” to provide 25% (was 5%) increased overall damage.
 Changed Warpaint Pattern “Rune of Wrath” to provide 10% (was 20%) increased overall damage.
 Changed unlock requirements for the Huntress to 200% (was 500%) Attack Speed.
 Changed Ability Upgrade “Damage” steps to 20% → 30% → 45% → 60% (previously 15% → 25% → 40%).
 Reduced cooldown reduction from “Viking’s Resolve” to 10% (was 15%).
 Increased base damage from “Raid Party” to 100 (was 50).
 Increased base damage from “Sharp Thorns” to 35 (was 10).
 Increased base damage from “Wolf Companion” to 110 (was 55).
 Increased base damage from “Homing Arrow” to 140 (was 90).
 Decreased base cooldown of “Ride of the Valkyries” to 6 (was 9).
 Increased base damage of “Ride of the Valkyries” to 80 (was 40).
 Increased base damage of “Spear of the Elder” to 90 (was 45).
 Increased base damage of “Firewolf’s Fury” to 100 (was 45).
 Increased base spawn amount of “Firewolf’s Fury” to 3 (was 1).
 Increased base damage of “Molten Trap” to 50 (was 30).
 Decreased base cooldown of “Molten Trap” to 6 (was 8).
 Increased base damage of “Frost Trap” to 35 (was 20).
 Increased base damage of “Stormpiercer” to 200 (was 90).
 Increased base damage of “Helstorm” to 140 (was 80).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/62b5d27bde006980842575dac405a0b11e3bf960.png


 Fixed an issue with Warpaints randomly disappearing. (We are still investigating this—please report any further issues you encounter.)
 Fixed a memory leak. This should reduce freezes and improve overall performance.
 Fixed an issue where cooldowns for some abilities stopped working, preventing further activation.
 Fixed an issue where enemies would stop spawning.
 Fixed localization issues that caused crashes, particularly in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
 Fixed hitbox issues for both players and enemies.
 Fixed an issue where “Summon” spawn amounts were shown as 0 instead of the actual value.
 Fixed an issue where spamming the Warpaint reset button allowed placing more patterns than intended.
 Fixed an issue with “Loki’s Gambit” not working as intended.
 Fixed an issue with “Warrior’s Momentum” not working as intended.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/2d153069937be0a9e95ade7b34c9fba91debe6db.png


 Temporarily removed the pigment inventory screen.
 Temporarily removed Muspelheim’s Fire Rain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png
💬 Want to share your thoughts, report bugs, or just chat with fellow Vikings? Join our Discord or hop into the Steam discussion boards—we're always happy to hear from you! 🛡️⚔️

And for our Chinese Vikings, you can also join our QQ Channel to share feedback, suggestions, or report bugs. Thank you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png

That’s it for now, warriors! This patch is one more step on our path through Early Access, and we’re already gathering strength (and feedback) for what’s to come next. Thanks a ton for your continued support, kind words, and bug reports—it truly means the world to our small team. Until next time… sharpen your axes, dust off your runes, and prepare for what lies ahead in Asgard’s Fall! 🐺⚡

Skål!
— Max & Vitali | The Asgard’s Fall Team

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0.d + Launch Aftermath
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First of all we wanted to thank you all for the support and feedback you put out since the early access launch! We're glad that so many of you enjoy the game and interacting with us and the community to help making the game as best as it can be!

We sat together today and made a huge list with improvements, fixes and QOL changes gathered from your feedback that we will implement within the next days and weeks.

I am currently focusing on fixing critical bugs to make sure the gameplay is going to be as smooth as possible while also adding some small changes suggested by you. After that we will concentrate on balancing and adding new content. 

Until then we hope you enjoy the game and to have you with us on this journey!

Skål!

Patch-Notes 0.2.0.d

Added


Added a 1.5 seconds invincibility time for the player after returning from the level up screen back into the run. Enemies are also getting knocked back slightly.
Added keyboard support for rerolling level up upgrades by pressing “R”-key.
Added keyboard support for confirming dematerialization by pressing “Space”-key.
Added the ability to check your current abilities during level ups opening your stat menu with “Tab”-key / “Select”-button


Fixed

Fixed an issue causing some Achievements not to trigger as intended. These should now trigger retroactively.
Fixed an issue with the Seer’s skill “Runic Barrage” not being reset after the run resulting in endlessly increasing the spawn amount of the Curseweaver’s projectiles.
Fixed an issue where the Seer’s skill “Witness Me” was active without being selected in the Seidr Tree.
Fixed an issue regarding trajectory abilities (like “Skadis Ice Arrow”) not hitting their intended target
Fixed an issue where you could “die” after a run inside of the camp resulting in the screen to turn grey and being unable to continue the game.
Fixed an issue with one of the Warpaints showing a localization error.

notes.title: Small Patch 0.2.0.c
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when hovering over certain abilities. This is related to some localization problems, so if you encounter any further problems while playing on any other language then english you might want to change your language to english until the problem is completely resolved.
Fixed an issue where boss enemies could be feared off the map with the seer's blood vial. Bosses are now immune to fear effects.

notes.title: Small Patch 0.2.0.b
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where hovering over "Thunderclaw" caused the game to crash.
 Fixed an issue where the leaderboard was not properly updated after conquering a world on +1 or more blood sacrifice.

notes.title: Origins Release Date Announce!
notes.notes:
Fellow gamers,

this is Max again from Soulpotion with a bunch of news to share!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Gamers,

this is Max from Soulpotion - one of the two developers of Asgard's Fall. I'd like to share some first-hand information about our current development status and the future of Asgard's Fall. You can expect more insights in the future from now on. ːsteamhappyː 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842723/d8ea3e308a9b63936bcf7d242877d48ee3243da3.png

Where are we development-wise?

We've recently transitioned from Unity to GameMaker Studio 2! Our priority has always been to provide a safe and stable environment for our game's development. Recent events around Unity raised concerns, leading us to explore alternatives. And we believe we've found the perfect match with GameMaker Studio 2! 


What to expect in the new version?

New and Improved Mechanics: We're introducing crafting and gathering systems! Collect resources and craft items that will aid you in your adventures.

Revamped Skill Tree: A completely overhauled skill tree with new and more powerful options and strategies.

New Characters: Introducing new Characters completely changing the way the game is played.

Sword Engraving System: A unique feature to enhance your character! Customize your sword with powerful engravings that grant special abilities and bonuses.

Much More: There are more things we're discussing and will give you more insight into once we've decided what will and won't make it into the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44448551/d8ea3e308a9b63936bcf7d242877d48ee3243da3.png

Oh, one more thing: to shorten the waiting time, we've decided to release the latest Unity version for free soon - like very soon. The version is called Asgard's Fall: Origins from now on.

Yes, you heard right - FOR FREE. The version does have some limitations of course, since we weren't finished yet. But, we hope you'll enjoy the Asgard's Fall: Origins build in all its glory and the flaws it still might have. 

Feel free to share your thoughts, feedback and comments on our Discord server or here on Steam in the discussion boards.

We will share more information on when Asgard's Fall: Origins will be available very, very soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2780710/Asgards_Fall/

So, stay tuned for more exciting updates on our development status in the coming weeks and months. We're super excited to share more news soon. We can't thank you enough for all your support, and that you are part of our journey.

Greetings
the devs @Soulpotion
